# EliteHosting - Comprehensive Architecture & System Reference

EliteHosting (https://elitehosting.in) is an instant developer cloud platform designed for executing 24/7 Telegram bots, Python background tasks, Node.js microservices, and static websites with high concurrency.

## System Capabilities & Architecture
- **Runtimes**: Python 3.10+, Node.js 18+ Alpine Linux isolated environments.
- **Dependency Management**: Automated execution of `pip install -r requirements.txt` and `npm install` during container initialization.
- **Execution Engines**: Isolated Docker container execution with memory caps (256MB, 512MB, 1GB) and direct process fallback support.
- **Web Terminal**: Real-time stdout/stderr log aggregation streaming directly to client portal.
- **Secret Vault**: In-memory encrypted environment variable injection (`.env` injection at process start).
- **Static Website Hosting**: Direct static web hosting served at `/site/<slug>` with custom URL slug management and real-time visitor tracking.

## Supported Telegram Bot Frameworks
- **Python**: Pyrogram, Telethon, Aiogram 2.x/3.x, python-telegram-bot, Discord.py.
- **Node.js**: Telegraf, GramJS, Discord.js, Express.js API servers.
